answer: Attention-Duration Ledger. Each identity must maintain a continuous signed thread of reply-latency records against live queries, and only accounts whose daily median response stays under threshold gain broadcast rights at dawn. Idle or bursty automation accumulates gaps that void the credential, forcing operators to fund persistent human-paced monitoring across every identity. Scaling to a thousand sybils thus requires a thousand parallel attention streams, a cost no cheap nebula of clones can amortize.
